youtube_title: Say It Again, I'm Recording: The Apple Cider Stand
description:
Darlene drives back to the farm stand to get four dollars back for cold donuts. She starts filming. That was her first mistake.
By the end she has a hayride ticket, a corn maze map and a cat who calls himself management.

lines.text: Excuse me. These apple cider donuts are cold. I want my four dollars back.
Ma'am, I hear you. Let me explain.
Oh, you'll explain. Say it again. I'm recording.
Say it again? Gladly. These are the coldest donuts in the whole county.
Chilled. On purpose. Hot donuts are for amateurs.
That is not a thing.
It became a thing about four seconds ago.
Who said that? Is the cider talking?
I am a jug, madam. I have been here since nine. I have seen things.
Here is the move. Cold donut. Hot cider. Dunk it.
Okay. One dunk. For the video.
Oh no. Oh, that's good. Why is that good?
One large cider. Running total, eight dollars.
I came here to get money back, not spend it.
Also, there is hay in my shoe. Explain that. On camera.
Say it again? That is not hay. That is a free sample of our hayride.
Twelve minutes. One tractor. Earl drives.
Earl waves at every cow by name. The cows wave back.
Cows do not wave.
Not at you. You have not been on the hayride.
Fine. One hayride. Keep talking, I'm still recording.
Running total, twenty one dollars.
Last thing. Your cat hissed at me in the parking lot.
Ma'am. That is not a cat. That is Mayor Pumpernickel.
I do not hiss. I give feedback.
The cat talks too? What is in this cider?
Apples, mostly. Say it again. I will wait.
Have you seen our corn maze? Forty acres. Two exits.
One of the exits is real.
How long does it take to get out?
Most people are home by Thanksgiving.
And every maze ticket comes with a pumpkin. You pick it. It picks you.
I want the lumpy one. The one that looks like my uncle.
Maze, pumpkin, uncle. Running total, eighty seven dollars.
Eighty seven? I came here for four dollars!
And you are leaving with an experience.
That's it. Everybody is going to see this video.
Wait.
The camera was flipped. I was recording my own face the whole time.
How much of your face?
Forty minutes. It's just me. Nodding. Saying yes to a hayride.
You nodded beautifully. Very loyal customer energy.
Okay, but the donuts are still cold. Nobody explained why.
The donut warmer works perfectly, madam.
Somebody sleeps on top of it from nine to five.
Mayor.
I am the warmest thing on this farm. That is called management.
So the cat is warm and the donuts are cold.
Everyone gets what they deserve.
Ma'am, I am so sorry. Here is your four dollars.
Keep it. My sister wants a hayride. She saw the video.
Two large ciders for the hayride, then?
Say it again. I'm recording. Camera facing the right way this time.
The donuts are cold, ma'am.
I know. I'll take a dozen.
Running total, one hundred and twelve dollars.
Where do I go for a refund?
The corn maze. Second exit.
